Scores are snapshots and change over time. IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, and Metacritic values are stored per movie; the Metacritic enrichment was matched by title and release year on August 4, 2026. A missing Metacritic score means Metacritic has no published score or no matching page—not a zero. September additions use verified IMDb and RT snapshots with direct source links. Earlier entries retain their prior snapshots. September additions include separately verified Metacritic scores. Entries without a Metacritic score are hidden only when that axis is selected. Lead tags marked unclassified have not been reviewed. Imported RT CSV data can replace embedded audience values with exact audience scores and counts.
